# Per-package statement-coverage floors for `make coverage-gate`.
#
# Each floor is the coverage measured on the v1 integration branch minus a
# 2-point margin, so ordinary refactoring has room but a real regression fails.
# `default` is the backstop for a package that is not listed: add an explicit
# floor in the same pull request that introduces the package.
